Digital marketing

Improving the speed of a WordPress site

Check a representative page on a phone before changing the entire site. The homepage, a long article and a product listing may have very different bottlenecks.

In this guide
Find the slow elementTry a reversible changeCheck the customer journey

Find the slow element

Use PageSpeed Insights to review the site and compare field data, when available, with the test result. Pay attention to what visitors wait for, such as a large banner image or a late-loading menu.

Try a reversible change

Resize an oversized image to a suitable display size and compress it before uploading. Test updates to caching, templates or plugins on a staging copy with a backup. Work on one change at a time.

Check the customer journey

Repeat the same test, then open the menu, submit a test form to an approved destination and try the booking or shopping flow. A faster page should still let visitors finish their task.
